_provenance_note: SCHEMA-CRAFTED fixture — NOT a live capture. The ORNL/DOE EAGLE-I public historical dataset (DOI dataset 1975203; mirrored at openenergyhub.ornl.gov/explore/dataset/eaglei_outages_2014) requires an account/download session to pull bulk files, so it cannot be fetched programmatically from this environment (DATA_SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md §4 EAGLE-I row). These rows are hand-authored to match the DOCUMENTED public schema for the dataset (FIPS code, county name, state name, customers-without-power, customers-total, 15-minute timestamp) as described in the ORNL/OSTI dataset listings. They illustrate one 15-minute snapshot across Butte County, CA and four adjacent Northern-California counties during a hypothetical wildfire-driven outage — a realistic but fictional scenario for the BEACON demo, not an observed event.
